senses.gloss: f. (שְׁרֵי) [rest, encampment,] meal, refreshment (cmp. סְעוּדָה); ration, sustenance.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 29:22">Targ. Y. Gen. XXIX, 22</cite> (not <cite ref="U01065"><he>שירוי</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 40:30">Targ. Job XL, 30</cite>.
Targ. Gen. XLIII, 16 (dinner time; h. text צהרים).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 25:30">Targ. II Kings XXV, 30</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 39b:10">Ber. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>הוה בצע אכולא ש׳</he> used to break bread enough for the entire meal.
<cite ref="Taanit 11b:2">Taan. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>האי בר בי רב … ליכול כלבא לשֵׁירוּתֵיה</he> if a student fasts, let a dog eat his meal.

<cite ref="Pesachim 113a:3">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>סלקת לאיגרא שֵׁירוּתָךְ בהדך</he> if thou goest up to the roof (on a journey ever so short), take thy provisions with thee; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="U01064"><he>שֵׁירָוָון</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Hosea 4:8">Targ. Hos. IV, 8</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="U01066"><he>שִׁירְוָן</he></cite>).
